title: Las --- The Plural Article That Behaves
label: ch:articles-las
canDo: I can say las casas and las comidas, putting the plural -s on both the article and the noun.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C44-las: produce las casas and las comidas and say how many new rules the chapter added.
payoff.note: Adds no rule. The chapter-one -s rule turns out to apply to the article as well, which is agreement doing what it has always done.
